parsed_json.up: Select: canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source: metabolism, compound_records (as substrate), compound_records (as parent), compound_structures. Join: metabolism.substrate_record_id = substrate_compound_records.record_id; metabolism.drug_record_id = parent_compound_records.record_id; substrate_compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: metabolism.organism = 'Callithrix jacchus'. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, substrate_compound_name ASC, parent_compound_name ASC, met_conversion ASC, pathway_key ASC, organism ASC, enzyme_name ASC. Limit: 200.
